notes:
Trim, compress, crop and rotate now pick their encoder when they run.

Groundwork for Windows: these four lanes used to have Apple's encoder baked into their signatures. They now ask the machine at the moment they do the work. On a Mac the answer is the same as it has always been.

One real bug fell out of it — compressing a ProRes file forces a different codec, since ProRes cannot be rate-controlled, and it was forcing an Apple-only one by name.
